hero.title: Scalable trust
hero.p1: True Aim is a Swiss company, spun out of Yarowa, Switzerland's leading insurtech, and supported by Innosuisse, the innovation arm of the Swiss government, on the strength of the technology we have built.
hero.p2: We are building towards an industry where the answer arrives at the speed of the evidence, where every decision records the facts, the rules and the reasoning behind it and where that record holds up under audit, regulatory review or dispute.
hero.p4: It asks for precision beyond what the market demands today, honesty about which decisions a machine should compute and which require human judgement and the discipline to solve the problems the industry is actually facing.
hero.p5: This is the work we have chosen.
hero.imageAlt: The True Aim symbol in glass and metal

mission.label: Mission
mission.text: To bring scalable trust to claims decisions. Every decision fast enough to matter, accurate enough to rely on and proven whenever it is questioned.
mission.attribution: Reuben John, CEO of True Aim

reuben.name: Reuben John
reuben.title: Co-founder and CEO
reuben.bio: As CEO, Reuben leads True Aim’s strategy, commercial growth and investor relations. He spent seven years as DACH Managing Director of a global tax technology company, growing the business across the region, and before that practised corporate and commercial law.

frederic.name: Frédéric Brunner
frederic.title: Co-founder and CTO
frederic.bio: A software engineer for more than 25 years, Fred began his career in the aerospace industry, focusing on data science. He has spent the last 15 years building enterprise claims systems as an enterprise architect at Zurich Insurance as well as at Guidewire.

arnaud.name: Arnaud Terville
arnaud.title: Sales Director
arnaud.bio: Arnaud brings nearly two decades of business development and go-to-market experience in the insurtech space. Formerly at Solera, Tractable and Quantexa (and before that Apple and Adobe), he now leads True Aim’s enterprise sales and partnerships.

alin.name: Alin Koppandi
alin.title: Senior AI Engineer
alin.bio: A senior engineer specialising in agentic AI, Alin leads the agent layer and the data pipeline that power the True Aim platform. He turns the latest advances in AI into reliable, secure production systems that claims teams can trust every single day.

kai.name: Kai Praschma
kai.title: AI Solutions Specialist
kai.bio: Kai builds the automation that runs True Aim’s operations and client delivery. Working closely with the CEO across strategy, commercial and go-to-market, he turns research into the tools, content and systems the whole team relies on every day.

henrique.name: Henrique Ferreira
henrique.title: Solutions Executive
henrique.bio: Henrique guides claims teams from the very first conversation to a running platform. He shapes each deployment around the client’s own claims, invoices and damage reports, so every team sees real results on its own data from the very first week.

claudio.name: Claudio Gienal
claudio.title: Insurance transformation
claudio.bio: Currently Chief Transformation Officer at AXA Group. Formerly CEO of AXA UK and Ireland, Group Chief Strategy Officer at Zurich and CEO of Zurich Life Switzerland. He began his career at Accenture and McKinsey before moving into the insurance industry.

kevin.name: Kevin Sartori
kevin.title: Company building and scaling
kevin.bio: Co-founder and former co-CEO of Auterion, the ETH Zurich spin-out now valued at more than USD 1.2 billion. Currently a board member at Pionix and a mentor with Project Switzerland. Master in Robotics from ETH Zurich, MBA from UC Berkeley and ex-BCG.

dave.name: Dave Stoll
dave.title: Insurance, innovation and strategy
dave.bio: Formerly CFO of Zurich Insurance Spain, Dave brings deep expertise across insurance, finance, innovation and strategy, from steering a national insurer’s finances to backing new insurtech ventures. Currently Director at vertX IQ and founder of doppo.

lukas.name: Dr Lukas Lichtensteiger
lukas.title: Technology architecture and AI
lukas.bio: Harvard graduate with an MSc in theoretical physics and a PhD in AI and robotics. Currently a lecturer at ZHAW, where he heads the Medical Complex Systems Group. A serial founder whose start-up Siltectra was sold to Infineon for EUR 124 million.

eric.name: Eric Zielinski
eric.title: Go-to-market and scaling
eric.bio: Currently leading go-to-market and expansion at Prosper AI, the a16z-backed start-up, where he has been instrumental in shaping its revenue expansion strategy. Formerly a consultant at Bain & Company, with an MBA from Wharton, and a US military veteran.

dandolo.name: Dr Dandolo Flumini
dandolo.title: Decision logic and mathematics
dandolo.bio: Mathematician with a PhD summa cum laude from the University of Bern, specialising in logic and theoretical computer science. Researcher at ZHAW and the original architect of MIRA, the award-winning decision technology now used by True Aim.
